name: Zero: The Lonely Man
source:
You've been crushing on your coworker, and it's no secret. Weber is a kindhearted man who treats everyone gently, what is there not to love? Lucky for you, it seems he feels the same way, and now the two of you are out on a date!

All is going well until a group of thugs tries to mug you on the way home. Suddenly, Weber's personality drastically changes, and he defeats the thugs before you can blink. Your date, who is now calling himself Zero, leaves you to fend for yourself. What exactly just happened, and when all hell breaks loose, will you be able to keep up with him or will you be just another victim?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.zerostart]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
你一直暗恋你的同事，这已经不是什么秘密了。韦伯是一个心地善良的人，对待每个人都很温柔，有什么理由不去爱呢？你很幸运，看来他也有同样的感觉，现在你们两个出去约会了！

一切都很顺利，直到一群暴徒试图在你回家的路上抢劫你。突然，韦伯的性格发生了巨大的变化，他在眨眼之间就击败了暴徒。你的约会对象现在自称零，让你自己照顾自己。到底发生了什么，当一切乱七八糟的时候，你能跟上他还是只是另一个受害者？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.zerostart]Google Play[/url]]
